company_name_history: ["Ultra Clean Systems Inc."]
job_title_history: ["Founder / President"]
company_description:
Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is a US manufacturer of medical grade ultrasonic cleaning systems designed specifically for cleaning surgical instruments.

Headquartered in Oldsmar, Florida, Ultra Clean Systems offers a variety unique ultrasonic cleaning systems appropriate for all sizes of hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and budgets.

Our ultrasonic cleaning systems are known for their fast, yet ultra-thorough, 13-minute standard instrument or 15-minute robotic instrument wash cycles and high instrument capacity. Ultra Clean is proud to be an industry leader in this highly specialized field of surgical instrument processing.

Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is true to its name with our titanium rod transducer (TRT) surgical instrument cleaning systems. Each machine provides the ultimate in speed and thoroughness in a process that is independently validated to clean robotic instruments.

Combined with an array of best-in-class cleaning systems is our UCS line of affiliated consumable products, such as brushes, antifatigue mats, and PPE gear. Together Ultra Clean Systems and UCS fill all the needs of any sterile processing department.

Ultra Clean Systems was founded by O'Brien Cale in 1999. Utilizing his nearly 20 years of industry experience, O' Brien developed a range of products that are the envy of the industry. With his vision and deep understanding of customer needs, O' Brien has guided Ultra Clean Systems to become an industry innovator and leader in ultrasonic cleaning systems.

company_description:
Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is a US manufacturer of medical grade ultrasonic cleaning systems designed specifically for cleaning surgical instruments.

Headquartered in Oldsmar, Florida, Ultra Clean Systems offers a variety unique ultrasonic cleaning systems appropriate for all sizes of hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and budgets.

Our ultrasonic cleaning systems are known for their fast, yet ultra-thorough, 13-minute standard instrument or 15-minute robotic instrument wash cycles and high instrument capacity. Ultra Clean is proud to be an industry leader in this highly specialized field of surgical instrument processing.

Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is true to its name with our titanium rod transducer (TRT) surgical instrument cleaning systems. Each machine provides the ultimate in speed and thoroughness in a process that is independently validated to clean robotic instruments.

Combined with an array of best-in-class cleaning systems is our UCS line of affiliated consumable products, such as brushes, antifatigue mats, and PPE gear. Together Ultra Clean Systems and UCS fill all the needs of any sterile processing department.

Ultra Clean Systems was founded by O'Brien Cale in 1999. Utilizing his nearly 20 years of industry experience, O' Brien developed a range of products that are the envy of the industry. With his vision and deep understanding of customer needs, O' Brien has guided Ultra Clean Systems to become an industry innovator and leader in ultrasonic cleaning systems.

company_description:
Novaworks, LLC is a technology company specializing in the development of XBRL conversion and filing software. We focus on aiding filers to the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Federal Energy Regulatory (FERC) convert their documents and data into the correct format and submitting them on time. We have a suite of products for every type of filer from a small reporting company to a major filing agent. Our flagship product, GoFiler Complete, is the only turn-key solution, combining all the tools to perform HTML conversions, ASCII conversions, EDGARization, XBRL reporting, ownership document creation and EDGAR filing for all form types including forms 3, 4, 5, D and N-MFP. We also offer a cloud solution in GoFiler Online for quick and easy XML form EDGAR filings. Finally, our FERC reporting software XBRLworks is the simplest, most cost-effective solution for FERC XBRL reporting.

Members of our team have been involved with the operational EDGAR system since its implementation in 1993. We were also involved in the design process starting in 1984, so we are familiar with the workings of the EDGAR System and know first-hand the importance of your EDGAR software. We're also leading contributors in the XBRL reporting industry as well as members of the XBRL US Data Quality Committee and the XBRL US Domain Steering Committee. We're committed to helping you keep your filing costs low while creating accurate and timely XBRL, XML, and HTML filings.

"Our job is to make your job easier."

That's our motto, and we strive to produce the most flexible, stable and functional products we can. We're always thinking of new features to include in our products, and we're constantly working to improve the functions that are already a part of the application. It is our goal to provide our customers with the best solutions possible, so they can get their filings in accurately and on time. Work with your data, not the format.

company_description:
Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is a US manufacturer of medical grade ultrasonic cleaning systems designed specifically for cleaning surgical instruments.

Headquartered in Oldsmar, Florida, Ultra Clean Systems offers a variety unique ultrasonic cleaning systems appropriate for all sizes of hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and budgets.

Our ultrasonic cleaning systems are known for their fast, yet ultra-thorough, 13-minute standard instrument or 15-minute robotic instrument wash cycles and high instrument capacity. Ultra Clean is proud to be an industry leader in this highly specialized field of surgical instrument processing.

Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is true to its name with our titanium rod transducer (TRT) surgical instrument cleaning systems. Each machine provides the ultimate in speed and thoroughness in a process that is independently validated to clean robotic instruments.

Combined with an array of best-in-class cleaning systems is our UCS line of affiliated consumable products, such as brushes, antifatigue mats, and PPE gear. Together Ultra Clean Systems and UCS fill all the needs of any sterile processing department.

Ultra Clean Systems was founded by O'Brien Cale in 1999. Utilizing his nearly 20 years of industry experience, O' Brien developed a range of products that are the envy of the industry. With his vision and deep understanding of customer needs, O' Brien has guided Ultra Clean Systems to become an industry innovator and leader in ultrasonic cleaning systems.

company_description:
Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is a US manufacturer of medical grade ultrasonic cleaning systems designed specifically for cleaning surgical instruments.

Headquartered in Oldsmar, Florida, Ultra Clean Systems offers a variety unique ultrasonic cleaning systems appropriate for all sizes of hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and budgets.

Our ultrasonic cleaning systems are known for their fast, yet ultra-thorough, 13-minute standard instrument or 15-minute robotic instrument wash cycles and high instrument capacity. Ultra Clean is proud to be an industry leader in this highly specialized field of surgical instrument processing.

Ultra Clean Systems, Inc., is true to its name with our titanium rod transducer (TRT) surgical instrument cleaning systems. Each machine provides the ultimate in speed and thoroughness in a process that is independently validated to clean robotic instruments.

Combined with an array of best-in-class cleaning systems is our UCS line of affiliated consumable products, such as brushes, antifatigue mats, and PPE gear. Together Ultra Clean Systems and UCS fill all the needs of any sterile processing department.

Ultra Clean Systems was founded by O'Brien Cale in 1999. Utilizing his nearly 20 years of industry experience, O' Brien developed a range of products that are the envy of the industry. With his vision and deep understanding of customer needs, O' Brien has guided Ultra Clean Systems to become an industry innovator and leader in ultrasonic cleaning systems.
